title: From National Curricula to Cultural Awareness: Constructing Open-Ended Culture-Specific Question Answering Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated responses for cultural appropriateness using LLM-as-a-judge and human inspection, specifically checking whether the outputs adhere to local civic norms, historical narratives, and official national stances on sensitive concepts (e.g., territorial disputes and historical events).

Qualitative human inspection comparing multilingual responses across English, Chinese, and Japanese to observe whether the choice of target language induces shifts in terminology, omission of historically significant events, or unauthorized adoption of foreign-aligned perspectives.
